title.zh: 将三宝颜市 Pasonanca 描笼涯一所中学的附属校分离，改设为独立的 Pasonanca 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Don Pablo Lorenzo Memorial High School – Pasonanca Annex in Barangay Pasonanca, Zamboanga City From the Don Pablo Lorenzo Memorial High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Pasonanca National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Pasonanca của Trường Trung học Tưởng niệm Don Pablo Lorenzo tại Barangay Pasonanca, Thành phố Zamboanga khỏi Trường Trung học Tưởng niệm Don Pablo Lorenzo và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Pasonanca Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Pasonanca ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอนุสรณ์ Don Pablo Lorenzo ในบารังไกย์ Pasonanca เมือง Zamboanga ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอนุสรณ์ Don Pablo Lorenzo และยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pasonanca แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Pasonanca, Sekolah Menengah Memorial Don Pablo Lorenzo di Barangay Pasonanca, Kota Zamboanga dari Sekolah Menengah Memorial Don Pablo Lorenzo dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Pasonanca Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana

text.en: The Don Pablo Lorenzo Memorial High School – Pasonanca Annex in Barangay Pasonanca, Zamboanga City is hereby separated from the Don Pablo Lorenzo Memorial High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Pasonanca National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Don Pablo Lorenzo Memorial High School – Pasonanca Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Pasonanca National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Pasonanca National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Don Pablo Lorenzo Memorial High School – Pasonanca Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
